name: Briggs Ranch Trip
blurb: A Tom Fazio course in San Antonio, about 30 minutes from the airport. Fly in Thursday morning and you're on the first tee after lunch.
travel: About 30 minutes from the San Antonio airport. Book a flight that lands Thursday morning. If you can't, fly in Wednesday night and book your own hotel, or arrive a little later and miss lunch and a couple of holes. Plan to fly home Saturday late afternoon or early evening.
itinerary:
Thursday, March 25: Welcome lunch, then golf until dark. First class over and after dinner (2.5 to 3 hours).
Friday, March 26: Breakfast, golf, lunch, golf, then class over dinner (2.5 to 3 hours).
Saturday, March 27: Breakfast, golf, lunch, then depart.
courseTitle: The Ins and Outs of Implant Placement: From Beginning to End, From Simple to Complex
courseSummary: Because this CE course is taught in an intimate setting, where you get to know Dr. Khang and your fellow classmates on the course and outside the classroom, course objectives may change slightly based on the background knowledge of the participants.
golf: Golf every day of the trip, played in a tournament-style format.
lodging: Accommodations at the club are included.

name: Dormie Club Trip
blurb: A Coore & Crenshaw course in the North Carolina sandhills, about an hour from the Raleigh airport. This trip adds a morning class on the last day.
travel: The Raleigh airport is about an hour away. Plan to arrive Sunday morning for the welcome lunch, and to leave after golf on Tuesday afternoon.
itinerary:
Sunday, April 18: Welcome lunch, then golf until dark. First class over and after dinner (2.5 to 3 hours).
Monday, April 19: Breakfast, golf, lunch, golf, then class over dinner (2.5 to 3 hours).
Tuesday, April 20: Breakfast and a morning class, then golf starting at 11:30. Depart after golf.
courseTitle: The Ins and Outs of Implant Placement: From Beginning to End, From Simple to Complex
